subjects.title: What Sandbox analyzes and why a file may not be
subjects.lead: Basic Sandbox analyzes only .exe, .dll, .scr, .ocx, .sys and .zip files up to 2 MB.

subjects.title: Sandbox custom MD5 hash list
subjects.lead: Sandbox keeps a custom list of MD5 file hashes it blocks, under /zia/api/v1/behavioralAnalysisAdvancedSettings: GET reads the list and PUT replaces it.

subjects.title: Files stuck in Sandbox quarantine
subjects.lead: For one-time download links the URL stops serving the file after the first request, so later download attempts return 404 or 403 from the origin.

subjects.title: Sandbox reports, quota, and trusting report content
subjects.lead: The report is fetched by MD5 as a summary or a full report; a separate endpoint returns the Sandbox quota.

subjects.title: Sandbox rules: first-time file behavior and the default rule
subjects.lead: A rule's terminal action, `baRuleAction`, is ALLOW or BLOCK.

subjects.title: Submitting files to Sandbox and out-of-band inspection (Discan)
subjects.lead: The submit call sends a raw or archive file to Sandbox for analysis (up to 100 files per day).

subjects.title: Which engine blocked the file, and what a Sandbox verdict means
